scan_llm_responses.description: Also scan raw model output via before:llm.response, before the agent loop consumes it. A match drops the response's tool calls. Default false.

scan_stream.description: Also scan each text delta via before:llm.stream.chunk, before it is released, so a banned word under streaming is never shown rather than retracted afterwards. Defaults to scan_llm_responses; without it the engine turns streaming off for this plugin (core.streaming.response_gate_policy).

words.description: Inline word list; either []string or a single string.

word_files.description: One or more files containing one word per line.
